conjunction_release_note: The frozen enumerator stores release_collision=false and no extras when three_nonempty_regions fails. Marginal raw predicate counts additionally compute release collision without that shortcut; prefix/final counts are identical.

definitions.duplicate_count: At least one code has more raw joined disposition rows than distinct documents; pack membership multiplicity is retained.
definitions.mixed_presence_absence: At least one pack member has no recorded section link and at least one has a recorded section link.
definitions.multiple_codes: At least two disposition codes have at least one distinct document in the cohort.
definitions.nonempty_histogram: The conjunction-selected documents have at least one source_verified whole_target disposition.
definitions.or_changes_histogram: The per-code distinct-document histogram differs between conjunction-selected and disjunction-selected documents.
definitions.positive_count_variation: At least two distinct strictly positive typed footprint sizes occur among pack members.
definitions.release_collision:document_pair: Some typed section in L minus R has its (spec,clause) projection in the other document R.
definitions.release_collision:section_pair: Broad document conjunction using only (spec,clause) strictly contains the full-typed conjunction.
definitions.release_count_result_changes: The complete (document,maximum count) rowset differs after projecting away release before distinct counting.
definitions.release_winner_set_changes: The maximizing document set differs after projecting away release before distinct counting.
definitions.three_nonempty_regions:document_pair: L intersection R, L minus R and R minus L are all nonempty typed-section sets.
definitions.three_nonempty_regions:section_pair: The pack contains at least one document in each of B1 intersection B2, B1 minus B2 and B2 minus B1.
definitions.ties: At least two pack members attain the largest typed footprint size.

maximum_release_conclusion.construction_mechanism: The pinned SectionIndex resolver returns one selected section for each (spec,section number,target release) argument. The inspected per-CR builders pass fixed spec/release arguments and deduplicate full section IDs; all released cr_extensions records have unique document IDs as checked. This gives a construction-level explanation under those conditions, not an ontology axiom or a universal claim about future/multi-record materializations.
maximum_release_conclusion.cross_document_distinction: Within-document projection injectivity is compatible with cross-document release aliases. Membership and conjunction may therefore remain release-sensitive while footprint counting does not.
maximum_release_conclusion.current_records: Projection (spec,release,clause)->(spec,clause) is injective within every linked document in these five frozen materializations. Consequently every per-document distinct footprint count, maximum count and winner rowset is unchanged; all 15 release-sensitive maximum cells have zero eligible candidates.
maximum_release_conclusion.schema: Not an implication of SQLite schema or the typed identity definition. Different releases have different valid section IDs and the link table has no dependency forcing a single release for a projected identity.
